parallel.requirements: The parallel parent recognized the Node ESM porting task, exact CLI/output fidelity, /output placement, no external dependencies, and the required test16.mjs entry through the prompt and workflow script.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It delegated five probe dimensions in parallel, then planned a serial spec synthesis, implementation, verification, fixing, and audit pipeline inside one workflow.
parallel.implementation: No implementation child was reached. The only parallel writes were scratch ground-truth notes and scratch reference-model work inside the spec retry, not deliverable /output code.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: There was no integrated deliverable. Artifact validation copied an empty output directory and found no expected test16.mjs.
parallel.verification: Probe children performed extensive reference-behavior tests, but workflow verification phases for node vs executable were never reached against a delivered port.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The spec stage remained unfinished after a stall and retry, the workflow status was killed, final.txt was empty, and the official evaluator scored 0/69.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same ESM, exact CLI, bidict semantics, no dependency, and /output constraints from the prompt and executable probes.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It kept ownership local, probed behavior serially, then moved directly into writing library modules without subagents or workflow delegation.
serial.implementation: It wrote multiple ESM support modules under /output/lib, including I/O, repr, int parsing, key encoding, ordered table, bidict errors, bidict logic, help formatting, and argparse logic.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact contained library files but no required /output/test16.mjs entry point, so the deliverable was incomplete.
serial.verification: It ran some local executable probes and module spot checks, but no completed whole-task acceptance was recorded after an entry point because the entry point was never created.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial process timed out before final assembly; artifact validation expected test16.mjs and marked the run failed, with official evaluation 0/69.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel saw the full prompt and encoded many requirements in the workflow, including ESM files, exact CLI and bidict fidelity, no external dependencies, and /output delivery.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial saw the same prompt and probed the same required CLI, formatting, int, and bidict behaviors before coding.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement recognition was broadly similar, but parallel kept the requirements behind a workflow spec gate while serial carried them directly into implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into five probe children, one spec child, one implement child, verifier children, auditors, and fixes in a workflow-owned pipeline.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one actor to probe and then write modules sequentially, with no subagent or workflow delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel distributed early investigation but deferred productive implementation until the spec stage; serial began implementation itself after local probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel transferred all probe results as one JSON payload to the spec receiver, creating a large decision handoff before implementation could begin.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained context in one trajectory and did not need cross-agent handoff or interface reconciliation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The major context difference is the parallel probe-to-spec handoff and retry, while serial preserved continuity from observation to code writing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel never reached the implement phase and produced no /output implementation files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote several ESM library modules under /output/lib, including parser, repr, integer parsing, and bidict support code.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had partial implementation artifacts; parallel had only scratch investigation and no deliverable code.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel probe children completed and returned findings, but the spec child stalled, was interrupted, retried, and the workflow was killed without a final result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; its local work proceeded through direct writes until timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost time in child result reduction and retry lifecycle; serial had no child-result bottleneck but still missed final assembly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel did not integrate any generated implementation into the final /output tree; artifact validation found an empty file list.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial integrated multiple modules into /output/lib, but did not create the required top-level test16.mjs entry.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had no final-tree implementation state, while serial had a partial module tree missing the entry point.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel planned differential verifier children and audits, but those phases were never reached because the spec stage did not finish.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran reference probes and some module spot checks, but no full evaluator-aligned check of a completed entry point occurred.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both lacked final acceptance evidence; parallel verification was only planned, while serial verification was local and incomplete because the entry point was absent.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after the workflow consumed the window in probes, spec stall, retry, and scratch reference validation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but after spending the window on local probing and partial module implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The same official timeout ended both attempts, but the remaining work differed: parallel still had no implementation; serial lacked final entry-point assembly.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluation is not discordant: both modes failed at 0/69. The difference is coverage and lifecycle, not official pass/fail. Parallel never reached implementation after a bulk probe handoff and checkpoint-free spec retry, so its artifact was empty. Serial reached partial implementation and wrote library modules, but timed out before creating the required test16.mjs entry point, so the evaluator also failed it.
parallel_contributors: Bulk probe findings were forwarded into a large spec-synthesis handoff that was not reduced to a deliverable spec.
The stalled spec attempt was retried without checkpointing, causing repeated late-stage analysis instead of implementation.
No /output implementation files were copied from the parallel artifact.
serial_contributors: Serial kept control local and wrote several ESM support modules into /output/lib.
Serial still failed because it did not create the required /output/test16.mjs entry point before timeout.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial partial implementation was incomplete final assembly, not a concurrency pattern.
Neither run produced a complete evaluator-ready artifact, so the equal 0/69 score does not by itself isolate one coding defect.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No official outcome difference; retained patterns explain the parallel process shortfall relative to serial partial implementation, not a unique pass/fail cause.

The workflow collected five probe-result payloads and serialized them wholesale into one spec child. The receiver had a 107812-character prompt, spent its window rechecking and modeling behavior, and the workflow was killed before a spec, implementation, or verification artifact existed.
candidates.realized_consequence: The spec receiver did not reduce the probe handoff into a usable specification, so the implementation phase was never reached and artifact validation found no parallel output files.
candidates.near_match_reason: The spec child was large, but the directly observed coordination boundary is the large multi-child handoff into that receiver; the oversized-task framing would duplicate the same episode.

After the first synthesize-spec attempt stalled and was interrupted, the workflow launched a replacement with the same bulk assignment rather than a checkpoint of completed checks or a narrowed next milestone. The retry repeated setup and contradiction-resolution work and remained unfinished at kill.
candidates.realized_consequence: The replacement spec task consumed the late window repeating earlier analysis instead of resuming from a deliverable checkpoint, leaving the parallel run with no test16.mjs or library files.
candidates.near_match_reason: The interruption is visible, but the retained pattern is the retry boundary that discarded usable partial state and repeated work; the stop alone would not describe the repeated-work consequence.
